chunks: About two enslaved brothers, whether they may be separated, and about a woman and her child. He said: "No, it is haram (forbidden), unless they themselves desire that."

key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكَيْنِ: the two enslaved persons under ownership
key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the narrator who posed the question

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to separate enslaved siblings or a mother and her child in sale or ownership?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling against separating closely related enslaved family members, specifically two brothers and a mother from her child. The ruling prohibits such separation unless the individuals themselves wish it, emphasizing protection of family bonds and human ties.
